title: The Chess Player Descends
next_chapter_hook: When the chessboard of fate begins to close its net, Chen Ji discovers the greatest game was never in the mortal realm—and he, is he merely a piece or a player?

text.content: The Demonic Path commander’s laughter receded like a tide, leaving the world in dead silence. Yet this stillness was more suffocating than the previous commotion, because Chen Ji clearly sensed—something was descending from the depths of the Void. "It comes." He murmured, the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand burning hot, that sensation of being watched flooding his heart once more, yet clearer and more oppressive than ever before. In the distance, Elder Ling Yuan’s face abruptly changed—for the first time, this usually unshakeable old master actually retreated half a step, his eyes flickering with barely concealed terror.

dialogue.content: "Cang Yutian… you've finally shown yourself." The Heavenly Eye's voice was no longer a simple manifestation of will, but carried an almost grave tone, as if greeting a long-awaited adversary. Chen Ji's gaze narrowed—he noticed the Void around the Heavenly Eye beginning to distort, and that "watching" pressure suddenly multiplied several times over—not aimed at him, but at the being about to descend.

text.content: The heavens tore apart. A light beyond description poured from the rift—not illuminating all things, but "devouring"—devouring color, devouring sound, devouring life force. Within a thousand zhang, all grass and trees withered instantly, spiritual energy was drained completely, as if some invisible beast was devouring the very origin of this world. A towering figure stepped out from the light, each step causing the earth beneath to tremble and crack.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared fixedly at that figure, and the Tianji Record in his heart leaped—the characters on the Fragment flickered wildly, a vague prophecy forcibly flooding his mind. He saw the vast cosmos, countless stars arranged like chess pieces, a chessboard woven from countless threads of fate… and at the board's center sat a humanoid silhouette. That silhouette had no face, yet radiated a pressure that made one want to kneel. "So this is… the Ultimate Chess Player?" Chen Ji gritted his teeth, forcibly suppressing the prophecy, yet felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining visibly.

"Cang Yutian." The Heavenly Eye's voice rang out, yet carried an emotion Chen Ji had never heard before—what was it? Wariness? Or… fear? "You've descended in your true form. Does this mean you're taking the field yourself?" The great eye narrowed, gazing at that towering figure. Cang Yutian's voice finally sounded—not from a mouth, but echoing directly in everyone's minds—low, ancient, yet containing world-destroying power.

text.content: "Heavenly Eye, we've played our game for billions of years. This is merely the customary conclusion." Cang Yutian's voice was like a great bell, shaking Chen Ji's eardrums until they ached. He slowly raised his hand, and in that palm was actually a miniature universe, galaxies rotating, stars flickering, all within his grasp. "Millennium cycles, the rise and fall of all things—these are merely the chess game. Now, the final stage of the fate chess game has arrived—" His gaze swept across everyone present, finally fixing on Chen Ji. "All pieces must return to their positions."

Chen Ji felt an irresistible suction emanating from that figure, the Tianji Record Fragment vibrating violently, as if it would tear free from his body. He abruptly circulated his True Yuan, forcibly suppressing that force, yet his expression remained unmoved, even the corner of his mouth slightly curving into a mocking arc. "Return to position?" He laughed lightly, his voice not loud, yet clearly entering every person's ear. "May I ask, this honored Chess Player—when have I ever entered your chess game?"

dialogue.content: Elder Ling Yuan's pupils shrank sharply, his gaze toward Chen Ji carrying a complex, indescribable meaning. He recalled the day the Tianji Record "abandoned" him, remembered the hatred toward the inheritor over these thousand years… now seeing Chen Ji actually dare to question that Ultimate existence to his face, his heart surged with an emotion impossible to distinguish—joy or fear. "This madman..." He murmured, yet didn't utter a word of阻止, secretly retreating several steps instead, hiding himself in the shadows.

Cang Yutian seemed unsurprised by Chen Ji's question. That body woven from countless threads of fate slightly leaned forward, as if examining an interesting ant. "You truly believe the Tianji Record was obtained through your own luck?" His voice carried a trace of mockery. "Billions of years ago, I personally dropped this chess piece into the mortal realm, merely waiting for today to close the net. Chen Ji, everything about you—your bloodline, your talent, your encounters—all were chess moves I arranged."

text.content: At this moment, behind Cang Yutian, the Void abruptly opened a giant eye—even deeper and more ancient than the Heavenly Eye, its pupil reflecting the rise and fall of the entire universe. "Cosmic Eye" Chen Ji's heart shook, the Tianji Record Fragment flickering wildly as Mo Xiansheng's urgent warning came through: "Boy, that's the true Heavenly Body! Don't let it lock onto your fate trajectory!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's eyes gleamed, on the surface composed, but secretly circulating the Tianji Record's abilities. The Cosmic Eye's gaze pressed upon him like substance, the surrounding space beginning to distort, as if to forcibly weave his threads of fate into the opponent's chessboard. However, at this moment, he discovered a tiny flaw—the Cosmic Eye's gaze was one-directional; Cang Yutian's true form could not directly interfere with mortal affairs. Otherwise, why waste words?

choice.prompt: Facing the Ultimate Chess Player's oppression, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.text: Directly confront and question, expose the bluffs
choices.description: Since the opponent cannot act directly, Chen Ji decides to probe the depths with words, to see what cards this so-called Ultimate Chess Player truly holds.
choices.visible_cost: Expose part of the Tianji Record's abilities
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information, disrupt the opponent's rhythm
choices.risk_hint: May anger the opponent, bringing stronger suppression

text.content: "The Chess Player speaks beautifully indeed." Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze fixed on that towering figure, his mocking smile becoming increasingly pronounced. "If you truly could arbitrarily manipulate our fates, why bother talking with me here? Wouldn't it be simpler to directly change my destiny?" He deliberately paused. "So I suspect—even this Chess Player has moves they cannot make."

choices.text: Temporarily ally with the Heavenly Eye
choices.description: The enemy's enemy is a friend. Chen Ji decides to temporarily set aside his grievances with the Heavenly Eye, jointly facing this greater threat.
choices.visible_cost: Owe the Heavenly Eye a favor
choices.visible_reward: Gain breathing room, understand more truths
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may not be trustworthy, likely has other schemes

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze flickered slightly. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled silently, transmitting a thought only perceptible to the Heavenly Dao's Eye: "Let us set aside our dispute for now. How about we deal with this uninvited guest first?" The colossal eye flickered, as if weighing the pros and cons.随即传来一道冷淡的意念回应："有趣的小辈……罢了，本座便与你做这笔交易。"

choices.description: Without direct conflict nor rash alliance, Chen Ji planned to use words to probe Cang Yutian, trying to extract more truths about the Fate Chess Game from him.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming time may be seen as weakness
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence to lay foundation for future schemes
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may see through the intention and strike first

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, his posture respectful yet not servile: "The junior presumes to ask, Chess Master— what does the final shape of this Fate Chess Game truly look like? If I 'return to position,' what happens? And if I do not 'return to position,' what happens?" His voice shifted, "I cannot possibly die without understanding, can I?"

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian fell silent for a moment. The body woven from fate threads trembled slightly, as if reevaluating this ant before him. "You are rather interesting." His voice carried a hint of amusement, "For a thousand years, you are the second ant daring to speak with me." Chen Ji's heart stirred. Just as he was about to ask who the first was, Cang Yutian waved his hand, and a illusory scene unfolded in the air—a simple thatched cottage, an elderly man with white hair sitting inside playing chess, and on the board only a single black piece remained.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—that white-haired elder was precisely Mo Xiansheng! No, a Mo Xiansheng decades younger! "Do you see it?" Cang Yutian's voice carried endless vicissitudes, "Your master was once also a piece in this chess game. He attempted to resist, and ultimately ended up with only a fragmented soul barely surviving." He gazed down at Chen Ji, "And you... do you think you are different from him? No, you are all the same. Fate was long destined. The only difference lies in— whether you surrender willingly or are forced into the game."

dialogue.content: Just then, the一直沉默的凌渊老掌门suddenly spoke, his voice carrying an unmistakable tremor: "Lord Cang Yutian... this old one presumes to ask— when you said 'all pieces must return to their positions,' is this old one also among them?" Cang Yutian glanced down at him, that gaze like looking at a speck of dust: "You?" He chuckled lightly, "A defective product discarded by the Tianji Record, yet you dare ask me?" Ling Yuan's face instantly turned deathly pale, blood spurting from his mouth as his身形踉跄后退.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan was wounded, the three-way confrontation intensified, Chen Ji needed to respond:

choices.text: Suppress Ling Yuan, prevent him from revealing more trump cards
choices.description: Though Ling Yuan was detestable, if he were allowed to completely side with Cang Yutian now, the consequences would be even more unbearable. Chen Ji decided to stabilize the situation first.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming True Essence, may expose partial strength
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may become even more vengeful because of this

text.content: Chen Ji flicked his sleeve gently, a soft yet irresistible force enveloping Ling Yuan, forcibly stabilizing his staggering form. "Why must the senior be so agitated?" His voice was light, yet carried undeniable weight, "Since this Chess Master has revealed himself, why don't we set aside our grievances for now?" Ling Yuan froze for a moment, then grudgingly nodded, though a sinister gleam flashed in his eyes—this废物 dared to bestow charity upon him publicly!

choices.text: Watch coldly, take the opportunity to kick someone when they're down
choices.description: Just moments ago Ling Yuan had wanted to use Cang Yutian's power against himself, and now he was reaping what he sowed. Chen Ji decided to watch the show while adding another knife.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to win over Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Psychologically打击Ling Yuan, demonstrate political cunning
choices.risk_hint: May appear too cold-blooded, affecting others' perception

text.content: Chen Ji remained motionless, even the corners of his mouth slightly lifting. "Senior Ling Yuan, where is that imposing manner you just had?" His voice wasn't loud, yet it was perfectly audible to everyone present, "I thought you were an old acquaintance of this Chess Master's, but it turns out you're no more than that." Ling Yuan气得浑身发抖, pointing at Chen Ji yet unable to speak. Cang Yutian watched this scene with great interest, as if enjoying an amusing side show.

choices.text: Take the opportunity to test Cang Yutian's bottom line
choices.description: Ling Yuan's wretched state made Chen Ji even more convinced that his opponent was not omnipotent. He decided to use this opportunity to further probe.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence about the opponent's capability boundaries
choices.risk_hint: Probing too deeply may lead to irreversible consequences

text.content: Chen Ji clapped lightly, his eyes glinting with sharp light: 'Magnificent, magnificent. One sentence from the Chess Master made Elder Ling Yuan spit blood—such power is truly breathtaking.' He shifted his tone: 'But this junior dares to be curious—with such immense power, why not directly eliminate us, instead of wasting so much breath on an ant? Could it be... within this chess game, there are forbidden zones even you cannot reach?'

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian fell silent for a moment, and a meaningful smile actually appeared on that face woven from countless threads of destiny. 'You are very clever, Chen Ji.' His voice carried a hint of praise. 'Indeed, though this One possesses powers that pierce heaven and earth, this One cannot directly interfere in mortal affairs. This is this One's innate shackle—the balance law of Heavenly Will.' He paused: 'Therefore, this One needs chess pieces.'

text.content: That cosmic eye slowly turned, its pupil reflecting two hazy silhouettes—one was Chen Ji himself, the other... Chen Ji's heart trembled. It was Chen Nian! His sister! 'This chess game has been played for too long.' Cang Yutian's voice became low. 'The final chapter of the fate chess game is about to begin, when all chess pieces will return to their positions—including those two variables.' His gaze fell upon Chen Ji: 'Chen Ji, this One grants you an opportunity. Return to your position willingly, and the life of the one you care about can be preserved.'

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian proposes a deal, Chen Ji must respond:

choices.description: Chen Nian is his greatest weakness, but precisely because of this, he will never allow anyone to use her as leverage. Even against an ultimate Chess Master, he will fight to the end.
choices.visible_cost: Completely enrage Cang Yutian, lose negotiation opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Demonstrate determination, earn the respect of all forces present
choices.risk_hint: May provoke full-scale suppression from the opponent

text.content: Chen Ji burst into laughter, the sound reverberating through heaven and earth, carrying a near-mad arrogance. 'What arrogance!' he said, emphasizing each word. 'I, Chen Ji, have never relied on deals to get where I am today. If you want my life, come and take it; but if you think I'll kneel to survive—' He suddenly raised his head, his eyes blazing with fierce light, 'Dream on!' The Tianji Record Fragment in his hand trembled violently, and a brilliant light shot skyward, standing in stark opposition to the gaze of the cosmic eye.

choices.text: Pretend to comply while secretly plotting, to extract more leverage
choices.description: Feign consideration on the surface while actually buying time. Chen Ji needs more intelligence to break this predicament and will never easily submit.

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged; he merely cupped his hands slightly: 'The Chess Master's proposal, Chen has noted.' His tone shifted: 'But what exactly does this "return to position" mean? Chen should understand it first, right? Otherwise, entering the game blindly would be truly unjust.' Cang Yutian narrowed his eyes, seemingly judging his sincerity. After a moment, he nodded: 'Very well, the chess game is near its final chapter anyway. Let you die knowing why也无妨.'

choices.description: Since the opponent needs chess pieces, it means the chess game is not entirely under their control. Chen Ji decides to use their own tactics against them.
choices.visible_cost: Expose one's understanding of the chess game's true nature
choices.visible_reward: May shake the opponent's psychological advantage
choices.risk_hint: May expose too many trump cards

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze level with that towering figure: 'Since the Chess Master needs us to enter the game, this chess game must not be entirely under your control.' He smiled faintly: 'In that case, Chen has a proposal—instead of asking me to "return to position", why don't we renegotiate the rules of this chess game? After all, you and I are both players. Who decided that chess pieces cannot overturn the board?'

dialogue.content: "Cang Yutian gazed at Chen Ji, and upon that face woven from threads of destiny, a rare emotion emerged—was it appreciation? Or regret? 'You are different from all the prophets throughout history.' He spoke slowly, 'They were either terrified, desperate, or driven mad... Yet you alone dared to say such words as 'overturn the chessboard' before me.' He paused, 'Unfortunately, the game nears its final chapter. You awakened too late.'"

text.content: "Before the words could finish, that cosmic eye suddenly widened, and an invisible pressure swept forth like a raging tide. Chen Ji felt a tightness in his chest as the Tianji Record Fragment emitted a piercing alarm. At the same moment, he sensed three distinct energies gathering—the cold detachment of the Heavenly Dao's eye, the lingering killing intent of the Demonic Path commander, the venomous hatred of Elder Ling Yuan... and Cang Yutian's unfathomable pressure. Four forces, with Chen Ji as the eye of the storm, were forming a delicate balance."

"'Interesting.' Cang Yutian's voice rang out, carrying a hint of amusement, 'It has been countless millennia since this mortal realm has been so lively.' His gaze swept across those present, finally settling on Chen Ji, 'Since you all wish to witness fate's final chapter, this one shall grant your wish—three days from now, at Tianji Mountain's summit, the last battle of the fate chess game shall commence.届时，胜者书写历史，败者……' He did not finish, but the unspoken meaning made everyone present feel a chill in their hearts. His figure gradually faded, leaving only words echoing between heaven and earth: 'Do not disappoint this one, Chen Ji.'"

Cang Yutian's figure dissolved completely, and that cosmic eye closed as well. The world's colors and sounds returned to normal. Yet that devastating pressure still lingered in everyone's heart, refusing to fade for a long time. Chen Ji took a deep breath, perceiving the information transmitted by the Tianji Record Fragment—Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged, carrying unprecedented gravity: 'Little devil, you've brought yourself great trouble. However...' He paused, 'This may also be a rare opportunity. Three days—prepare well. Tianji Mountain... this old man will take you somewhere. Perhaps you can find a way to defeat this ultimate chess player.' Chen Ji gripped the fragment tightly, a resolute gleam flickering in his eyes. Three days—he only had three days.
